content: Greenland is an autonomous territory within the Kingdom of Denmark. As such, the government of Greenland has the right to govern the territory, although Denmark retains certain powers over Greenland's foreign affairs, defense, and security. Ultimately, the people of Greenland have the right to self-governance and determine their own future, including potentially becoming an independent nation.
